hits.title: Marc DeBevoise Appointed OverDrive CEO - Publishers Weekly
hits.snippet: ADVERTISEMENT Home > News Brief # Marc DeBevoise Appointed OverDrive CEO Jun 23, 2026 Marc DeBevoise has been appointed CEO of OverDrive, succeeding founder Steve Potash in the role, the digital content provider announced today. The leadership transition was planned and is “designed to support OverDrive's continued growth and global expansion," per an announcement. DeBevoise, who previously held leadership roles at video platform Brightcove and online content network CBS Interactive, first joined Overdrive [earlier this year](https://www.publishersweekly.com/pw/by-topic/industry-news/libraries/article/99835-overdrive-taps-digital-strategy-expert-marc-debevoise-as-president.html) as president. "Founding and building OverDrive has been the most rewarding journey of my career," said Potash, who will stay on as chairman of the board, said in a statement. "With Marc leading as CEO, the company is exceptionally well positioned to grow and evolve. As Chairman, I look forward to supporting Marc and our team while continuing to champion the libraries, schools, and institutions at the heart of our mission." The leadership transition reflects a planned succession designed to support OverDrive's continued growth and global expansion. hits.snippet: # At OverDrive, Marc DeBevoise Named CEO; Steve Potash Becomes Chairman Marc DeBevoise has been named CEO of OverDrive, and founder and CEO Steve Potash is becoming chairman of the board. The company described the moves as "a planned succession designed to support OverDrive's continued growth and global expansion." | | | --- | |Marc DeBevoise | OverDrive has a large digital catalog of e-books, audiobooks, magazines, video, and other content, and mainly markets to libraries and schools. In 2020, [KKR bought OverDrive](https://www.shelf-awareness.com/issue.html?issue=3646) from Rakuten, which had purchased the company in 2015. [DeBevoise joined OverDrive as president](https://www.shelf-awareness.com/issue.html?issue=5176) in March and earlier was CEO of Brightcove, chief digital officer of Paramount, and CEO of CBS Interactive.
